# Run book: Look up an address

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/look-up-an-address.md) | [Spec](../specs/look-up-an-address.md)

## Contents

- [Purpose](#purpose)

- [Verify](#verify)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Purpose

Show the location contract behind one provider; the same call works with any other provider registered for it.

## Preconditions

- The API can reach the public US Census geocoder.
- The signed-in user holds the geocode.use right (the admin role).

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Look up an address"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/data/geocode`:

1. **Look it up.** The sample White House address is filled in; press Look up. Expect: The matched address, latitude, longitude and match quality are shown.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| No match for an address that exists | The Census service matches US street addresses only, and it is rate limited | Check the street, city and ZIP, then retry a little later |
| Forbidden | The user lacks the geocode.use right | Sign in with the admin role |

Related framework features: OoBDev.SpatialServices (`ILocationServices`); OoBDev.Census.Geocoding (`CensusLocationServices`).
